status: FROZEN by user approval 2026-11-12 (before any D* on this axis); supersedes v1 (candidate)
x_axis_primary: min(R1, R2) / L in reads/codon: PRE-thinning depth of the SHALLOWER of the two biological replicates (as defined in the approved PaperData_v1.0 data report); identical for both role assignments
input_depth_primary: natural depth: the deeper replicate is binomially thinned only to the shallower replicate's expected depth (REFERENCE_PROTOCOL); NO additional per-bin thinning
x_axis_sensitivity: per-bin thinned input library (v1 grid-thinning design), same transcripts at controlled depths
zero_depth: transcripts with 0 reads after thinning: reported as counts only (N_records, N_scored); never placed on the log axis, never interpolated
edges_note: v1 grid (12 log bins 0.01..1.5, ratio 1.5182) extended DOWNWARD with the same ratio to <= 0.0001 so that every positive depth falls in a bin (observed minimum positive depth 0.00011-0.00023 across the four datasets); bins with N_scored < 30 per role are invalid by rule
x_abscissa: log10 of the geometric centre of each bin (fixed by the edges, not data-dependent)
per_bin_value: for each role separately: median(model corr) - median(reads corr) over the SAME scorable transcripts; bin valid only if EACH role has N_scored >= 30; bin value = equal-weight mean of the two roles
interpolation: linear in log10 depth between ADJACENT valid bins only; an invalid bin breaks the curve (no interpolation across it)
sign: y > 0 positive; y <= 0 non-positive; crossing = positive -> non-positive between adjacent valid bins
uniqueness: exactly one crossing required; otherwise NOT_LOCATABLE
bootstrap: resample similarity units with replacement (both roles of a transcript, and all transcripts of a unit, drawn together); B = 2000; localization failure fraction > 0.10 -> NOT_LOCATABLE

wording.NO_SIGN_CHANGE: the paired difference did not change sign within [lo, hi] reads/codon
wording.NOT_LOCATABLE: no crossover could be located under the pre-registered rule

interpretation: D* is the crossover depth RELATIVE TO AN INDEPENDENT REPLICATE LIBRARY (a noisy reference); with a noisy reference the crossing of median correlations lies a few percent above the crossing against noise-free truth (synthetic check: 0.594 vs theoretical 0.5625). Bins are formed ACROSS transcripts at their natural depths: a per-bin difference mixes depth with transcript properties that covary with depth; the per-bin thinning sensitivity (same transcripts at controlled depth) addresses this

dataset_notes.GSE133393_WT: not deduplicated: depth includes PCR duplicates; not directly comparable with the other three datasets
dataset_notes.PRJNA_iPS: top bin [0.988, 1.5) empty and next bin 34 transcripts: analysable range ends near 0.99 reads/codon by the N_scored >= 30 rule

changes_vs_v1: x axis: post-thinning input depth -> min(R1,R2)/L pre-thinning (approved data report definition; role-invariant). Reason: v1 axis differed from the approved report, could move a transcript between bins when roles swap, and could exceed 1.5 after random thinning
input depth: per-bin thinning -> natural depth after expected-depth matching (per-bin thinning kept as sensitivity). Reason: primary axis then reflects the real low-coverage distribution

edges: extended downward with the same log ratio to 0.0001 (adds 12 bins). Reason: 0 < d < 0.01 held 9.6-22.2% of T_low and fell outside every bin; a single wide [0.0001,0.01) bin was considered (user-approved option) but rejected because its fixed geometric-centre abscissa (0.001) would misplace a bin whose transcripts lie mostly in 0.005-0.01, biasing interpolation; the uniform grid keeps one abscissa rule for all bins
PRJNA_iPS high-end empty bin: no edge change; invalid by rule; analysable range reported
added interpretation and dataset notes (reference-relative D*, cross-transcript binning, GSE133393 PCR duplicates)
reference_implementation: paper_eval/partII_crossover.py (definitions unchanged; only edges and axis inputs change)
